title: Resurrection of the Dead
definition: The resurrection of the dead is the future bodily raising of all people, believers to life and unbelievers to judgment.
summary: God will raise the dead, and believers will receive resurrection life through Christ.
christFocus: Jesus' bodily resurrection is the guarantee and firstfruits of the resurrection of His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christian hope is not escape from the body but resurrection. Scripture teaches that God will raise the dead. Believers will be raised to life, and unbelievers to judgment.

The resurrection of Christ guarantees the resurrection of His people. Because He lives, those who belong to Him will also live. Death does not have the final word over the body.

Resurrection hope gives dignity to the body, courage in suffering, and confidence in God's final victory over death.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people think of eternity in vague, bodiless, or sentimental terms. Resurrection matters because God's plan includes the restoration of embodied life under Christ's reign.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor your body as belonging to God, endure suffering with hope, and grieve death without despair. Let Christ's resurrection strengthen your confidence in the future resurrection.
